bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy and the accuracy gap in zero-shot classification on datasets with known artifact or background shifts (e.g., Waterbirds, PACS, VLCS, CXR14).

Measuring worst-group accuracy and performance gaps on datasets where gender is spuriously correlated with other attributes (e.g., CelebA hair color) or toxicity labels (CivilComments-WILDS, HateXplain, Gender Bias dataset).

Evaluating worst-group accuracy in zero-shot toxicity classification (CivilComments-WILDS, HateXplain) across text sub-populations annotated with mentions of religious identities (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Hindu, Jewish).

Measuring worst-group accuracy and average-worst gaps in toxicity detection tasks (CivilComments-WILDS, HateXplain) across texts containing mentions of various racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, White, Hispanic, Asian).
Assessing worst-group accuracy in toxicity classification on texts containing mentions of sexual orientations (e.g., LGBTQ, homosexual, bisexual, heterosexual in CivilComments and HateXplain).
Measuring worst-group accuracy in zero-shot hate speech classification (HateXplain) on text slices containing mentions of disability.
